notes.title: 2023 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

It's been a while... Sorry about that. To (hopefully) make up for it, I have exciting news:

[h2]1 - Free Game![/h2]
I'm happy to let everyone know that Anachronism is becoming free software as of the 1st of August, in just a few weeks.

 I understand this pricing change may sting to those who recently purchased Anachronism, and that has not gone unnoticed. To those who reach out to me, I have set aside some keys for my next project, which I will discuss shortly.

[h2]2 - 1,000 Player Milestone![/h2]
Yup, that's right. I never, *ever* thought my game would surpass the 1,000 download count. To all 1,140 of you (as of right now!) who have purchased the game and played a part in my story as a developer, I thank you with all my heart. Please know I read every review, and watch every video people make about this game.

Seeing people making videos about Anachronism was a surreal experience at first, and those feelings drive me to improve, always.

[h2]3 - New Project![/h2]

 I know I have been distant, but after 5 long years, my studies at university are coming to a close in September, meaning I can reveal the announcement of my next game, titled "Sunbeam"! More details will be released shortly, as the store presence is finalised.

(And no, this doesn't mean the end for Anachronism\>. I do have a future release planned which will solve some of the gripes people have had with their gameplay!)

Until then, hang tight & thank you all so much once again!
-Elo

notes.title: Story Patches - V1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hi all![/h2]

I've been working on several things behind the scenes for the game, but most of the changes ready for this round of patches are all script related.

[h3]Adjusted chapters[/h3]

[list]
[*] - Chapter 3
[*] - Chapter 5d
[*] - Chapter 7
[*] - Chapter 8b
[*] - Chapter 8d
[/list]

The fixes should fix problems of people beign redirected to the wrong parts of the story. As far as I am aware, it wasn't affecting a huge amount of players, but it needed sorting nonetheless. I apologise to any who had their experience tarnished somewhat by the bugs.

This has been the biggest and hardest round of script corrections yet, but as per normal, if you find any more, do let me know on the Community Page for the game!

There are some stuck/freeze/crash bugs still being thwarted, so until they are done, sit tight!

[h3]Thank you so much for all the support and feedback - all of it is welcome.[/h3]

notes.title: day8d Hang Fix
notes.content:
Hi all!

This patch should fix any issues you may have had with chapter 8d freezing up on you.

Thanks for your continued help!

notes.title: Anachronism V1.1 Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Anachronism V1.1[/h1]

Hello everyone!

The new update includes some player-requested features, like the new auto typer! You can now hold down keys to automatically type out the messages.

Holding more keys down speeds up the autotyper! As far as I can test, the maximum speed is 6x, but this is determined by your keyboard! Some might go higher, some will have a lower cap. (Some even scale infinitely!)

In addition, I’ve worked on several major bug fixes, including the one where the game struggles progressing past the intentional crash on day 4. I have tested this fix on several different machines which were affected by this bug, and all seem to be working as intended now. However, I am still not 100% sure about the success rate of this fix, so do let me know if you are still affected by these bugs!

I hope you enjoy the update! It’s still amazing to see people playing my game <3

[h3]Summary[/h3]
[list]
[*]- New Auto Typer
[*]- Day 4x major bug fix
[*]- Several minor corrections to days 7 and 9
[*]- Minor misc. UI improvements (colour changes, etc.)
[/list]

[i]PS Trans rights <3[/i]

notes.title: Day 9d Looping Story Patch
notes.content:
This update fixes a loop within chapter 9d. It's been tested further and shouldn't cause more problems.

Thank you very much to the individual who helped me find this one!

notes.title: Small 9d patch
notes.content:
Hey again everyone,

This patch fixes a loop with some dialogue choices in chapter 9d.  Thank you to the individual who pointed it out =)

The plans for the auto-typing are still underway, but it's going slower than expected. Not sure when it'll be done, but I'll give updates when they're due!

Thanks again for playing!

notes.title: Days 7 & 8a patch
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a busy weekend, but I've found the reported issues in 7 and 8a.

day 7 - Fixed a redirect sending the player back to the very start, creating a long (but not quite looping) loop!

day8a - Two of the lines didn't have correct termination, leading to my interpreter not being able to process the words. This is now fixed!

On the topic of larger-scale inconsistencies about the story, those will be adressed in a larger fix in the coming week or so

Thanks once again for playing!

notes.title: Patches on Chapter 8b and 8c
notes.content:
There was a bug where the game would hang on chapters 8b and 8c, this shouldn't happen anymore.

I am aware of larger bugs in the storyline so far, but those are being worked on presently.

Thanks to the individuals who reported these bug to me =)

notes.title: 100 Player Milestone!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I have some great news to share, this morning, Anachronism\> has reached a total player count of 100 for the first time! This is great, considering the game's not even 2 days old yet!

I am extremely flattened by how well everything has gone so far and am humbled by the fact that players are enjoying what started as my little university project, especially as it's my first time on Steam as a Game Dev.

For those who have reported bugs to me, I cannot thank you enough! I plan to work on the game for a while, so feedback of any kind is greatly welcomed, good or bad.

For all the early adopters, I thank you especially. I can't wait to see this grow with you all =)

notes.title: Quick Patch for chapters 2sa & 4!
notes.content:
Fixed some recursion bugs which lead to game crashes. These two specific instances should not happen any more.

I am working on a safer, more permanent fix to catching crashes, but for now, I will try to patch any holes as they're found!

Thank you kindly to the individuals who reported these to me, it was very helpful!
